findings.finding: Within this util assembly call inventory, CmsSignedData is used by FuncWS.CheckLongTermSignature token 0x0600038e for PDF/CMS inspection. This does not establish a standalone browser CMS-sign command. No standalone SignedCms/CmsSigner/CmsSignedDataGenerator call was found in the inspected util call-edge inventory. PDF signing APIs and XAdES code are present, but their existence is not evidence a given portal invokes them.

limitations: All method tokens and IL offsets are build-local and require the artifact SHA256 and MVID above.
Static CIL proves encoded calls/branches/dataflow, not successful Windows runtime execution, portal compatibility, supported token hardware, chain/revocation result, or completed business submission.
REA anchors are not a complete disassembly and omit switch destinations; branch conclusions above use full offline CIL supplied by the root investigation.
No credentials, PIN, key material, live document content, vendor implementation dump, or raw capture included.

Adapter should remain deferred until transport/envelope/action identity and actual portal request/response fixture are established; XML profile mismatch and DocumentType-dependent hashing semantics prevent a generic guessed adapter.
